Reproducibility and interoperability

Source: vignettes/v09-reproducibility-interoperability.Rmd
v09-reproducibility-interoperability.Rmd
library(agriLandSuit)

fp <- land_fingerprint(result)
manifest <- land_manifest(result, inputs = c(climate = "climate.tif"))
land_export(result, "analysis_bundle", format = "bundle")
restored <- land_import("analysis_bundle")
reproducibility_check(restored, manifest)

targets_template("_targets.R", use_geotargets = TRUE)

The bundle representation writes substantial spatial payloads to geospatial files instead of relying on raw external pointers. targets and geotargets are optional orchestration tools and remain outside the mandatory package runtime.
